name: Doctor of the Jungle Cauldron haste and Jungle Secrets effigy heal (#3070, #488)
contract: Both passives are pure spell-mod/dummy-trigger mechanics that need no ApplyContracts branch: their SpellFamilyFlags (706545 all zero, 707212 all zero on the passive's own record) never match any Family() test in AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:191-340. #3070: Ingredient: Jungle Shrooms 801660 (family 19, flags [0,128,128]) Effect0 is APPLY_AURA/SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, Amplitude 6000, TriggerSpell 802703; AttributesEx3 lacks SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS so it is spell-mod eligible. Doctor of the Jungle 706545 is APPLY_AURA/SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), EffectBasePoints -2001/DieSides1 -> -2000, EffectMiscValue 19 = SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (SpellDefines.h:95, within MAX_SPELLMOD 32), EffectSpellClassMask (0,128,0) which intersects 801660's flags on word1 (128). AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:770-800) registers this as a SpellModifier the instant 706545's passive aura is created (constructor at line 447 calls CalculateSpellMod() unconditionally), independent of 801660's own state, so the spell_modifier probe flips as soon as 706545 is learned. AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:673-720) recomputes m_amplitude from the DBC base every time it runs, including on an ordinary refresh: Aura::ModStackAmount (SpellAuras.cpp:1000-1003, reached because Jungle Shrooms' own StackAmount is forced to 1 by ApplyContracts' IsIngredient branch, :336-340) calls RefreshTimers(periodicReset) which calls aurEff->CalculatePeriodic(caster, periodicReset, false) for every effect regardless of the periodicReset flag -- confirmed by reading the function body, the flag only gates the periodic *timer* reset, not the amplitude/spell-mod recompute at the top of CalculatePeriodic. So simply recasting Jungle Shrooms while it is already active (a normal in-game action) is sufficient to pick up the new modifier; aura_amplitude_ms (CoAGameplayTest.cpp, AuraEffect::GetAmplitude()) reads the live, already-recomputed value. Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219-10327) for a non-CASTING_TIME/non-DURATION op computes basevalue*totalmul+totalflat = 6000*1 + (-2000) = 4000, matching CalculatePeriodic's own math. #488: Jungle Secrets 707212 Effect0 is APPLY_AURA/SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, BasePoints 34/DieSides1 -> 35 (the tooltip's 35%), EffectTriggerSpell 712348; witch_doctor_casts::OnSpellHitResult (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:180-203) checks Family(info,1,131072) -- Loa's Brew 801670 flags[1]=131072 matches -- and calls HealThroughEffigies (AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:79-95): requires player->HasAura(JungleSecrets), computes amount = healing * clamp(Amount(JungleSecrets,EFFECT_0,player),0,100)/100 (Amount() is SpellInfo::CalcValue, so exactly 35), radius from 712348's own EffectRadiusIndex 9 = 20 yd, iterates State(player).summons for an EffigySlot creature (Slot(entry)==EffigySlot for NpcShadow 50119 among others, AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:44-54), builds the Allies() list sorted ascending by GetHealthPct (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:62-77) so the lowest-health non-primary ally is allies.front(), and casts JungleSecretsHeal 712348 on it via Copy() (CastCustomSpell with SPELLVALUE_BASE_POINT0, caster=doctor). ApplyContracts' JungleSecretsHeal branch (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:527-536) sets DmgClass NONE, CANT_CRIT, IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS and BonusMultiplier 0, so the 35% ratio survives the copy unscaled by any of the caster's own healing modifiers or crit. The scenario asserts this ratio against 801670's own real logged heal from the same cast (spell_heal_total, not a synthetic base-1000 probe), so no coefficient is hard-coded. All DBC fields verified via coa-dbc-viewer against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset (Spell.dbc sha256 9d77d79e...4cfda234) on branch fix/coa-witchdoctor-audit; core call sites re-read directly from src/server/game in this worktree. CORRECTION (repair-witchdoctor-doctor-of-the-jungle-and-jungle-secrets.md): 'simply recasting Jungle Shrooms while it is already active' still has to clear the spell's own GCD (Spell.dbc 801660 StartRecoveryTime=1500 ms, StartRecoveryCategory triggers the standard global cooldown) before the second CMSG_CAST_SPELL is even accepted by Spell::CheckCast; without an intervening wait the recast is rejected with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY (reason 67, confirmed via result.json cast_failures on run b8eaf6bcc96f) and CalculatePeriodic never re-runs, so aura_amplitude_ms stays at the stale 6000. A 2000 ms wait before the recast (the same margin used in witchdoctor-cauldron-effectiveness-spellmods.json and witchdoctor-cauldron-utility-spellmods.json for the identical GCD-after-cast pattern) clears it. This was a scenario timing defect, not a mechanism failure: CalculateSpellMod/CalculatePeriodic themselves were never in question. A second, separate timing defect existed on the #488 side: Loa's Brew 801670 has a 2000 ms cast time (SpellCastTimes.dbc id 5, CastTime=2000), and the scenario's original 'no bonus heal yet' assertion (expected 0, already true at cast start) never forced a wait, so the baseline cast at step 'Loa's Brew on a1, without Jungle Secrets known' was still in progress when 'loa_before' was snapshotted and when the discriminating cast was issued; the discriminating cast was then rejected with SPELL_FAILED_SPELL_IN_PROGRESS (reason 105, confirmed via result.json cast_failures on run f5b5de38baa2), leaving loa_before/loa_delta at 0 and failing the final ratio assertion with 'Missing or zero ratio snapshot'. Fixed by asserting spell_heal_count for 801670 itself landing on a1 (equals 1, within_ms 3000) before taking the snapshot, so the harness polls until the baseline cast actually completes. The same pattern (an unforced instant assertion around a 2000 ms cast) also let the 'loa_delta' snapshot race ahead of the discriminating cast's own heal (run 93a29b496f6a: loa_delta snapshotted 0 because the cast was still in flight); fixed with the matching spell_heal_count==2 (target a1) wait before that snapshot too.
